entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. To place a new order, press two. For returns or exchanges, press three. To speak with a representative, please stay on the line.
(presses 3)
Thanks for calling VeloFit Customer Support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to make a return. My order number is VF58291.
Certainly. Let me pull up order VF58291... Okay, I see it here. It looks like the delivery was made 23 days ago. Which items were you looking to return?
I want to return the whole order. It was the blue Pro-Series jersey and the VeloBand Pulse.

Okay, I can definitely help you with that. Let's start with the jersey. That's well within our 90-day return window, so I've just approved that return. I've sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file for you. You can just pack it up and drop it off.
Great, thanks. And what about the Pulse?
Right, regarding the VeloBand Pulse... I'm afraid that item is not eligible for a return. I know it can be confusing when you order two items at once, but they sometimes fall under separate policies.
What do you mean 'not eligible'? I got them at the same time. Why is the jersey okay but this isn't?

I understand the confusion. Our standard apparel has a 90-day policy, but due to the nature of the electronics in the Pulse, it has a much stricter 10-day return window. Since it was delivered 23 days ago, the system has automatically locked the return.

Ten days? That's ridiculous! I didn't even open it until last week. This is completely unfair. I'm a loyal customer, and now I'm stuck with a $150 piece of tech I don't want. This is how you treat people?

I truly do understand your frustration, and I apologize that our separate policies weren't made clearer during your checkout. I know this is not the outcome you were hoping for. While I cannot process a refund to your credit card, I don't want you to be stuck.
So what are you going to do? Because right now I'm thinking of just returning the jersey and never shopping with VeloFit again.

Please don't do that. We value your business. Because there was a clear mix-up with the return expectations, I can make an exception. I can offer you a VeloFit store credit for the item. How does a $50 credit sound?
Fifty dollars? The thing costs three times that. That's not really solving my problem.

You're right. I apologize, that's just my starting point. Let me check the limits of what I can do here... Okay. Given the circumstances and your history with us, I can go ahead and issue a $100 store credit to your account. That's the absolute maximum I'm authorized for, but I think it's fair in this case. You could use it on a new helmet, shoes, or another jersey.
Oh. Wow. Okay, a hundred dollars. Yes, I can work with that. That's much, much better. I appreciate you doing that.

I'm so glad we could find a solution. So, to confirm: you're returning the jersey for a full refund using the label I sent, and I have just applied a $100 credit to your VeloFit account for the Pulse. It's active immediately.
That's perfect. Thank you, Alex. You really turned this around for me. I was pretty upset for a minute there.
It's my pleasure. Happy to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
